g.text: L A U N C H N E W H O M E P A G E
Build component library (▲3d), Optimize image assets (in 6d)
Go-live plan, agreed with marketing and support on Sep 22.
Feature-flag the new homepage for internal users first, then 10 % of traffic for one
full business day while we watch conversion, error rate and the p95 of the checkout
Lower the DNS TTL to 300 seconds two days before the cut-over so a rollback
Support gets the FAQ and the macro set one week before; the status page draft is
written in advance and kept unpublished.
Rollback: flip the flag, restore the old sitemap, purge the CDN. The runbook lives in
the ops wiki and was rehearsed on staging.
Risks: the component library slipped three days; if the asset pass slips too, launch
moves to the following Tuesday, never a Friday.
Owner on call during launch: username_subject.
